title: Why am I being charged a fee on my Navy Blue Account?
summary: Explains why you may see fees on a Navy Blue Account, listing charges for domestic wire transfers ($15.00), same-day ACH ($5.00), out-of-network U.S. ATM withdrawals ($2.50), and foreign ATM withdrawals (3% with a $5.00 minimum, with examples for $80 and $200). It also notes $0.00 monthly maintenance and $0.00 paper statement fees, how to confirm the fee via transaction details, and steps to avoid future fees (use standard ACH, Rho ATMs, e-statements, and fewer/larger foreign withdrawals).
